nodes.label: CyberAlchemy v2
nodes.meaning: The parent product whose human-agency, evidence, ownership, and honest-incompleteness commitments Essays must preserve.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: The parent Product is not the Essays subproduct or its implementation.

nodes.label: Essays
nodes.meaning: The proposed focused long-form writing subproduct.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Essays is not its Project, Goal, Whisper, editor, runtime, frontend, or an essay document.

nodes.label: Essays Product Thesis
nodes.meaning: The candidate proposition that writers benefit from continuous intent, artifact, review, revision, evidence, residue, and export state in one focused environment.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A Product Thesis is not proof of product value or implementation.

nodes.label: Essays Project
nodes.meaning: The CAV2-D60 coordination boundary for Essays product, ontology, research, construction, runtime, and evidence work.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: The Project is not the product, workspace folder, runtime, or DomainSpec project source.

nodes.label: Essays First Runtime Goal
nodes.meaning: The desired future result of one validated local Essays runtime and clean frontend constructed through CAV2-D65.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: The Goal is not achieved by ontology, code, tests, or file placement alone.

nodes.label: Writer
nodes.meaning: The person who owns the essay's intent and consequential editorial judgment.
nodes.owner_route: Essay author
nodes.forbidden_collapse: The writer is not a model, reviewer, runtime role, or inferred preference profile.

nodes.label: Reviewable Essay Outcome
nodes.meaning: A substantial essay whose text, intent, feedback, changes, evidence gaps, validation posture, and residue remain inspectable before clean export.
nodes.owner_route: Essay author plus Essays Product Capability owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: The outcome is not publication, product value, or universal writing quality.

nodes.label: Develop Governed Essay
nodes.meaning: Enable a writer to move from attributable intent through planning, drafting, addressable review, revision, validation, residue, and clean export.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Product Capability owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: The Product Capability is not Whisper, a workflow implementation, editor, interface, command, or runtime.

nodes.label: Whisper Spell Reference
nodes.meaning: A source-owned Arcanum composition spell that may realize part of Develop Governed Essay after a separate binding and conformance decision.
nodes.owner_route: Arcanum Whisper spell owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Whisper is not the Essays Product Capability, Essays Product, runtime, frontend, or an adopted Agent Capability instance.

nodes.label: Text Intent Substrate
nodes.meaning: The smallest explicit record of the text's audience, objective, resonance, relevance, trajectory, constraints, and known uncertainty.
nodes.owner_route: Essay author plus Essays Product Capability owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: The substrate is not the author's complete intent or a frozen draft.

nodes.label: Composition Plan
nodes.meaning: A reviewable construction plan for the essay's parts, sequence, narrative anchor, examples, surfaces, and validation checks.
nodes.owner_route: Essay author plus Essays Product Capability owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A composition plan is not prose, implementation, or permission to publish.

nodes.label: Draft Artifact
nodes.meaning: One version-identified essay draft with audience-facing text separated from authoring-only state.
nodes.owner_route: Essay author
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A draft is not author intent, final publication, or validation proof.

nodes.label: Addressable Editorial Review
nodes.meaning: Feedback records bound to stable artifact and text locations with explicit lifecycle and author disposition.
nodes.owner_route: Essay author plus review owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Review feedback is not an accepted revision or authority to change the draft.

nodes.label: Validation Report
nodes.meaning: A bounded report of structural, source, transport, and editorial checks with visible limitations.
nodes.owner_route: Essays validation owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A validation report is not editorial approval, truth, publication readiness, or product proof.

nodes.label: Editorial And Learning Residue
nodes.meaning: Named unresolved meaning, evidence, feedback, transport, or workflow remainder preserved after a writing pass.
nodes.owner_route: Essay author plus affected claim owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Residue is not permission to guess or an automatic task queue.

nodes.label: Audience-Facing Essay Export
nodes.meaning: A derived audience-facing representation that excludes authoring-only metadata and preserves its source draft identity.
nodes.owner_route: Essay author
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Export is not publication, distribution, release, or the canonical source draft.

nodes.label: Open-Source Writing Substrate Selection
nodes.meaning: The unresolved bounded choice of editor or writing-software components that may inform the first frontend after license and architecture review.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus license review owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A researched or selected upstream package is not the Essays Product, Product Capability, ontology, or permanent runtime owner.

nodes.label: Inspect Essays Product Model
nodes.meaning: Enable a person using Essays to inspect the definitions, products, projects, and ontologies bound to the current runtime candidate with provenance and authority limits visible.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Product Capability owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 ontology owners
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Inspection is not semantic mutation, registry ownership, ontology-runtime authority, acceptance, or proof of currentness beyond the displayed source epoch.

nodes.label: Inspectable Product Model Outcome
nodes.meaning: A person can understand which semantic records shape Essays and can distinguish their identity, status, meaning, ownership, provenance, and boundaries.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Product Capability owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: An inspectable model is not comprehension evidence, product proof, model acceptance, or permission to change semantic sources.

nodes.label: Product Model View
nodes.meaning: A version-identified read-only projection that groups bound semantic records and preserves status, owner route, provenance, boundary, and source epoch.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Product Capability owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 ontology owners
nodes.forbidden_collapse: The projection is not a canonical definition source, ontology registry, Project record, mutable graph, or acceptance receipt.

nodes.label: Definitions Collection
nodes.meaning: The Product Model View collection of canonical bindings and Essays-local definition candidates, each labeled by authority and status.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 definitions-governance owner plus Essays Product Capability owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A projected definition record is not promoted or canonical merely because it appears in the view.

nodes.label: Products Collection
nodes.meaning: The Product Model View collection of product identities and their candidate product meaning within the Essays boundary.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Essays Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A product projection is not the Product, its thesis, implementation, or proof of value.

nodes.label: Projects Collection
nodes.meaning: The Product Model View collection of governed project identities relevant to Essays, distinct from folders and DomainSpec manifests.
nodes.owner_route: Essays Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A project projection is not a repository directory, DomainSpec minted project, plan, goal, or execution authority.

nodes.label: Ontologies Collection
nodes.meaning: The Product Model View collection of product, capability, and generated system ontology identities with their branch and claim ceiling visible.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 ontology owners plus Essays Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: An ontology projection is not the ontology runtime, source graph, acceptance, or permission to infer across branches.
